name: Ashen Swarm
description:
About This Game

CASE: THE WORLD.

VERDICT: GUILTY.


The Judge knew not everyone was guilty.


He condemned the whole world anyway.


Now Corruption carries out the sentence: devouring the last lands and leaving the Void behind. You have already died trying to stop it. The Architect rebuilt you from ash—now you must reach the Judge and break the sentence while there is still something left to save.


Ashen Swarm is a gothic bullet heaven roguelite where the seven deadly sins become weapons and the court gathers above you during each run.

TURN SIN INTO A WEAPON




Pride drowns the swarm in filth, turns the rabble into squealing swine, and blows the herd apart. Wrath spreads fire through the crowd and burns the condemned to ash. Gluttony turns the fallen into food until the arena becomes a feast.


Keep the Oath while the Tempter searches for a way to talk you into falling. Or enter already tainted: your hero’s skill changes, and dangerous bargains let you raise Corruption for greater power—making every mistake more dangerous.


YOUR CHOICES HAVE CONSEQUENCES


A warrior asks you to watch her technique. She is good. Perhaps she will soon be better than you.


Encourage her—or show her a flawed move and call it advice. She will thank you either way.


On a later run, you will find her again—teaching new recruits or lying beside a broken blade.


And you have another choice to make.




THE COURT GATHERS ABOVE YOU


Every minute, another Juror takes a seat. At 13:13, the Foreman takes the thirteenth—and the Collegium descends into the arena to carry out the sentence.




Between runs, the Architect rebuilds the Effigy—the last one who reached the Judge and lost. Every permanent upgrade restores more of its body and strength. As you grow stronger, it becomes whole.


At the final judgment, that will prove either foresight—or a very expensive mistake.
short_desc: Rise from the ashes and defeat the Judge before his sentence devours the last lands. Cut through a swarm of the condemned in a gothic bullet heaven roguelite, turning the seven deadly sins into weapons. Decide whom to save, doom, or betray. Do not let the verdict become the world's final word.
